title: Let’s check the details
intro: We prepared the fields from your description. Review them and add what you know.
generationText: Turning your description into fields and checking specifications.
attentionText: Some values may need a second look. You decide what to keep.
extraIntro: The main details are ready. Check any additional information you have.
reviewIntro: Everything is in one place. You can still edit any section.
readyIntro: Your changes are saved. Download the card or return to editing.
error: Could not save your changes. Please try again.

issues.heavy_desk: This weight seems high for this example. Check it or confirm your value.

detailsTitle: Add details in your own words
